about: The pinned Godot editor (used headless, to import and export a game's project) and the one web template a game is exported with: WebGL2 (the compatibility renderer), single-threaded, so the page needs no cross-origin isolation. tools/install.mjs fetches and checks these only when a game picks runtime godot.

license.note: The exported game carries the engine (godot.js and godot.wasm from the template); gf/godot/LICENSES.md in every game names Godot's licence and its third-party notices.

contents.godot.wasm: the engine, 37.7 MB (about 9 MB compressed on the wire)

notYet: macOS and Windows editors are not pinned here yet: their archives have not been hashed and run on those systems. The web template is the same on every system, so a game exported on Linux plays everywhere.
